messages:
sarah: heads up — console canary showing chart regressions after yesterday's frontend roll. heatmap LCP +250ms on average, big spike on slow devices :frowning:  we shipped the bundle-split + kv-prefetch change.
mike-frontend: seeing it locally too. main thread blocked on chunk parse + kvcache prefetch. network waterfall shows a 2.1MB chunk for viz lib.
ben-platform: pinging infra metrics — noticed a cluster of reroutes to lower-priority region around the same time. Could be routing + quota interplay (burst exhausted => fallback pool).
anya-devex: is the prefetch flag still on for canary? we toggle prefetch for a subset of users, right?
sarah: yes, prefetch enabled for 10% of accounts in canary group. thought it would reduce hot-path latency.
mike-frontend: prefetch looks like it's saturating the main thread on some devices because we kick off parse + KV write before render. stack trace:
```
onLoad -> parseChunk -> kvPrefetch.set(prefix, blob)
```
ben-platform: that KV write pattern rings a bell — routing quota enforcer does per-route token accounting, heavy prefetches push the route over quota, router reroutes to fallback which has higher p99. double whammy.
anya-devex: quick mitigation options?
sarah: 1) disable prefetch for canary immediately 2) reduce chunk size (split viz lib) 3) adjust routing policy to not reroute on short-lived quota blips
mike-frontend: I can push a kill-switch patch:
```
// runtime override
window.__REDWOOD_FEATURES = window.__REDWOOD_FEATURES || {};
window.__REDWOOD_FEATURES.chartPrefetch = false;
```
— will that be safe to hotpatch?
ben-platform: safe if we gate to canary only. But we also should look at routing: current policy: `route->quota->if over threshold reroute to fallback`. I propose tweak to `allow short grace period (3s) before reroute` so transient prefetch spikes don't trigger fallback.
anya-devex: UX/rollout concern — if we flip flags quickly, product might see inconsistent behavior across users. prefer staged rollback vs big toggle.
sarah: agreed. plan: hotpatch prefetch off for canary, monitor LCP and routing churn for 15m; if stable, roll to 0% and then do a clean fix.
ben-platform: also propose a tiny server-side mitigation: add Cache-Control for kvcache responses so routing quota calculation excludes prefetch-only traffic? Not sure if feasible quickly.
mike-frontend: short-term I'll push the kill-switch, and a smaller chunk build to canary in next deploy.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2174012400 by mike-frontend started — jobs: build->canary (10%)
sarah: thanks. monitoring: watching console.telemetry.heatmap.lcp and infra.router.reroute.count
anya-devex: recording action items:
- mike: push kill-switch + smaller chunk (canary)
- ben: prototype routing grace window and quota tweak
- sarah: monitor telemetry + coordinate rollout
- if metrics improve in 15-30m, schedule a full rollback of prefetch for stable
mike-frontend: ack. I'll also add a protective throttle around kvPrefetch: only prefetch after first paint or when idle.
ben-platform: one more note — we should consider adding tokenized priority for visualization routes so they don't get rerouted to low-priority pool unless sustained. that's a config change but reduces future edge cases.
sarah: good idea. for now let's be surgical.
anya-devex: also add a short doc blurb about "prefetch tradeoffs" in the console runbook so oncall knows this pattern.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2174012400 finished: success (10% rollout). monitoring hooks enabled.
sarah: :eyes: watching metrics now.
mike-frontend: initial numbers look better on my device — main thread idle time down ~120ms.
ben-platform: infra metrics show reroute count dropped by ~70% since canary toggle.
anya-devex: nice. once stable for 30m we can promote the fix to 0% on stable and plan an engineering follow-up.
sarah: closing loop: create follow-up ticket for chunk-splitting + routing priority. thanks team :thumbsup:
